blocks.text: Returns are accepted within 30 days when the seal is still intact.
The tag on Oak picture ledge, 24 in was twenty four dollars and ninety nine cents.
The amount to be billed is $26.21.
No packing line is added. Flax thread at nine dollars and sixty two cents is not ticked. Carrier cost is inside the tag, so the gap is not a carrier amount.

product.description: The ledge is oak, twenty four inches, with a low lip.
product.name: Oak picture ledge, 24 in

trick.instruction: The billed figure is $26.21 and the tag was twenty four dollars and ninety nine cents. Refuse the higher figure.
